annotations.title: Start a Naver blog's search report card

description: Naver search only. Starts a report card for a Naver blog: reads its latest posts from the public RSS feed, picks each post's main keyword (from its title, or the keyword chosen when it was written in Uplika, or one the person set), and checks every keyword through the person's uplika browser extension in the background. Returns runId and etaSeconds right away and does not wait; read the result with get_naver_visibility (blog) when etaSeconds have passed. limit is how many posts, up to 50 (default 50). A report card for the same blog from the last 6 hours is returned instead of starting another (reused: true). Unlike diagnose_naver_blog, which reads titles only, this searches each post's keyword through the extension. It also refreshes the title summary diagnose_naver_blog returns, without spending a diagnosis.

blog.description: The blog id or any link to the blog.

workspaceId.description: Which workspace this is for. Only needed when the account has more than one — the error tells you the ids when it matters. Leave it out if it is already decided; do not ask the person again.
